description:
# TAPP Composition Module: Aggregation

The shared **Aggregation** block of the 2026-08-11 TAPP library, composed by **13 of the sixteen** delivery tables — 2 owned fields over 1 schema paths.

Generated by `tools/build_module_bb.py` from `Module_Aggregation.csv` and its schema-path sidecar. Edit those, not the schema.

This is a **profile, not a vocabulary**: it asserts which properties a conforming procedure or analysis carries, all of them already defined by `tappDefinition` or `adaProduct`.

## The two `$defs`

| `$def` | composed into | properties | required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AnalysisIdentification` | a technique detail (`schema:Dataset`) | 1 | 0 |

Requiredness follows the TAPP tier matrix: a field Basic on a side is required there, Advanced is permitted, N/A is absent from that side entirely.

## Composing it

```yaml
allOf:
- $ref: ../../../BaseSchema/tappDefinition/schema.yaml
- $ref: ../../../BaseSchema/modules/aggregation/schema.yaml#/$defs/ProcedureIdentification
- type: object
  properties: {}   # only what this technique itself owns
```

`allOf` composes constraints and cannot relax them: a technique composing this module accepts its required set in full.

$schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
title: 'TAPP Composition Module: Aggregation'
description: "The shared Aggregation block of the 2026-08-11 TAPP library (Claude
  Skills for TAPP/Module_Aggregation.csv), composed by 13 of the sixteen delivery
  tables. 2 owned fields over 1 schema paths.\n\nGENERATED by tools/build_module_bb.py
  from the module's CSV and its schema-path sidecar \u2014 edit those, not this file.
  Requiredness follows the TAPP tier matrix: a field Basic on a side is required there,
  Advanced is permitted, N/A is absent from that side entirely.\n\nThis is a PROFILE,
  not a vocabulary: it asserts which properties a conforming procedure or analysis
  carries. Column F (Example / Allowed Content) is consumer-owned per the module manifest,
  so no enum is pinned here \u2014 a consuming TAPP may narrow a value space, never
  widen it."
$defs:
  AnalysisIdentification:
    title: Aggregation on the analysis
    description: 'Composed into a technique detail (schema:Dataset) schema: what each
      run supplies fresh, because it cannot be known until the analysis happens.'
    type: object
    properties:
      schema:variableMeasured:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          allOf:
          - if:
              properties:
                schema:name:
                  const: Goodness-of-Fit or Dispersion Statistic
              required:
              - schema:name
            then:
              properties:
                schema:value:
                  description: The statistic reported to show whether scatter among
                    the contributing analyses exceeds what analytical uncertainty
                    alone predicts, together with its value. Answers whether a reported
                    aggregate is defensible as a single population. Procedure-level
                    tier is N/A because the value cannot be known before the analysis;
                    the procedure may still state an acceptance threshold, which belongs
                    with the inclusion criteria.
                  anyOf:
                  - type: string
                  - type: array
                    items:
                      type: string
                  x-jsonld-id: http://schema.org/value
        allOf:
        - contains:
            properties:
              schema:name:
                const: Goodness-of-Fit or Dispersion Statistic
            required:
            - schema:name
        x-jsonld-id: http://schema.org/variableMeasured
  Param_Procedure_analysisInclusionAndRejectionCriteria:
    title: Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteria
    description: 'The rules determining which individual analyses contribute to a
      reported aggregate result, together with the outcome of applying them: how many
      analyses were acquired, how many were included, and on what grounds any were
      excluded. Distinct from within-analysis outlier filtering, which removes anomalous
      points inside a single analysis: this field decides which whole analyses enter
      the reported value. Criteria and outcome are combined in one field because neither
      is interpretable without the other, following the precision/accuracy precedent.'
    type: object
    properties:
      '@id':
        const: ada:parameter/module/Aggregation/analysisInclusionAndRejectionCriteriaDefault
      '@type':
        const:
        - schema:PropertyValueSpecification
      schema:valueName:
        const: analysisInclusionAndRejectionCriteriaDefault
        x-jsonld-id: http://schema.org/valueName
      schema:name:
        const: Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteria
        x-jsonld-id: http://schema.org/name
      ada:dataType:
        const: string
      ada:fieldScope:
        const: session
      schema:readonlyValue:
        const: false
        x-jsonld-id: http://schema.org/readonlyValue
      ada:tier:
        const: R
    required:
    - '@id'
    - '@type'
    - schema:valueName
    - schema:name
    - ada:dataType
    - ada:fieldScope
x-jsonld-prefixes:
  schema: http://schema.org/
